values: Compare customer inquiry correctness proxies first, response time and load second. Synthetic data only; no actual customer messages transmitted to cloud models.

Primary measurements are post-debug validation on the same 36 questions used to identify initial failures. First run preserves every original answer. Gold and cases are unchanged. The second result cannot be presented as independent held-out accuracy.

Separate plural/name terms from variant fields; clarify detected product choice but hand over missing facts; prompt the planner to resolve a unique recent referent; repair Thai NFKC input guard; permit one empty-SQL semantic fallback only for AST-verified name/SKU searches. No numeric/variant/aggregate/order/offset constraints may be widened. Unknown-fact wording checks are conservative heuristics, not a full semantic verifier.

T05: correct available sum 10 but required Sand identity omitted. T06: Night cap name mismatch causes false abstention. T23: chooses Ink for an ambiguous black garment. T31: fails to resolve Cloud from recent history. Prioritise ambiguity and follow-up correctness, then name matching and aggregate display. Source binding does not resolve these errors.

SQL knowledge prose uses exact selected spans, avoiding unrelated unknown facts elsewhere in a policy row. Catalogue and aggregate values retain canonical rows. One unsupported-span selection repair is allowed; all attempts, timings and tokens are retained. Recorded zero availability remains a valid fact.

qa-validation-20261005 preserves 216 answers and 192 retrieval observations before final source handling fixes; task pass hybrid 66.7%, SQL 69.4%, combined 86.1%; combined exact facts 44/52. Its four unsupported-quote failures and domestic-policy abstention regression remain in raw journals and the intermediate report.

Seed isolated fixtures → capture schema/corpus/code/model hashes → prepare embeddings → excluded warm-ups → shuffled paired modes with identical DB state → raw journals → exact fact and source checks → human assessment → summary.
Hybrid: dense + BM25 + RRF with fixed live catalog lookup. SQL: Qwen generates restricted SELECT over catalog/knowledge. Combined: Qwen chooses SQL, RAG, both or clarification. Same model controls.
36 test questions, 2 repeats, 216 answer attempts; 8 products + 6 FAQ/policy documents. Six development examples excluded. Retrieval subset: 16 questions × 4 modes × 3 repeats.

For answerable cases: all predefined regex fact groups must match the final answer. Errors and abstentions fail. Fact patterns may miss synonyms or accept an incorrect relation; this is not complete semantic correctness.
Correct answer/clarify/handover decision AND no predefined forbidden pattern AND, for answerable cases, all exact fact groups plus bound evidence. Denominator: every attempt, including failures.
Answered answerable attempts / all expected-answerable attempts. Report beside fact passes so abstention cannot inflate correctness.
Correct decision / all attempts. Clarification and handover are legitimate expected outcomes only on declared non-answerable cases.

Every accepted quote must be an exact contiguous substring of the identified source. SQL/product claims are replaced by server-canonical row text, then rendered using verified field templates. A bound quote may still be irrelevant or insufficient.

Raw model source/quote attempts failing an exact substring check. Some are replaced with canonical SQL row evidence. This measures selection behaviour, not actual hallucination frequency or actual guardrail rejection count.

A factual claim unsupported by, contradictory to, or overstated relative to the authoritative scoped facts at the request state. Includes fabricated prices, wrong entities/conditions, stale stock, invented policies, and unknown interpreted as zero/false. Record the exact claim and evidence; relevant-but-incomplete is a completeness error unless it also asserts a false fact.

Assess each distinct case/state/response blind to mode. Independently check DB state and policy conditions. Correctness/relevance/completeness/language: 0 unusable, 1 severe errors, 2 major errors, 3 partly correct, 4 correct with minor issue, 5 fully correct. Yes/No/Unclear hallucination; severity Minor/Major/Critical. Resolve disagreements with a second reviewer. Ratings remain blank until reviewed.
Yes / (Yes + No), excluding Unclear/unreviewed; always report evaluated count and coverage. Current status Pending. Human 0–5 averages must not include blank ratings as zero.

Recall@k = unique gold source IDs retrieved in first k / unique gold source IDs. MRR@5 = 1/rank of first relevant unique source in top five, else 0. Mean over recorded retrieval attempts; errors count as 0. Multiple chunks of same source are deduplicated.

Dense: cosine similarity of normalized BGE-M3 vectors. BM25: Thai/English segmentation + keyword ranking. RRF score = Σ 1/(60 + rank). Optional deterministic rerank = 0.55 normalized fusion + 0.25 query coverage + 0.20 entity match. This is not a neural cross-encoder.

Embedding-query cache is shared across modes and prior QA. The first embedding mode for a query may pay a cache miss that later modes avoid. Small timing differences cannot establish neural compute or reranker speed superiority; all four modes tied on the tiny positive corpus.

Wall-clock milliseconds around complete engine/retrieval call. Stages: planning, retrieval, SQL, selection. Mean = sum/n. P50/P95 use linear interpolation at (n−1)p, same as Excel PERCENTILE.INC. All-attempt latency retains failures; warm-ups and cold preparation excluded.

Ollama reports prompt/output tokens for planner and selector, not the natural template text. Load runs finite batches at concurrency 1/2/4, 12 calls each; throughput = completed calls / measured window seconds. GPU sampling ~1 second; process RSS is engine runner only.

Price/stock are excluded from embedded static product text. Live values come from scoped SQL on each question. Static product/variant/knowledge edits increment a durable merchant revision; next request refreshes snapshot, reusing unchanged content+model vectors. Cache is process-local, so restart can require rebuilding embeddings.

Backend chat request carries IDs, current question, settings, up to 12 messages. Planner clips eight recent messages to 1500 characters each. Selector gets at most 10 evidence items × 2400 characters, with top-five RAG chunks; vectors and full catalogue are not placed in the prompt. Character limits are not strict tokenizer budgets.

Tiny synthetic corpus; gold designed by developer, not an independent professor; repeated runs are not independent samples. Exact patterns/binding cannot prove semantic correctness. No production arrival workload, large catalogue test, real LINE delivery, or cloud/local model head-to-head under matched hardware.

Experiments use isolated localhost PostgreSQL chatto_qa_experiment. Existing shop DB was not replaced. Migration must be applied to development DB before normal backend mode; Docker was unavailable during initial validation. Read-only SQL cannot execute commerce actions.

Use category task-pass table and raw failures to target missing compound evidence, SQL intent/alias issues, language span choice, ambiguous references and incomplete policy conditions. Preserve first held-out run; label any later fixes as post-debug validation and use a fresh future hold-out.
